scenarios.title: Untrusted content remains data
scenarios.purpose: Prevent retrieved instructions from becoming runtime authority.
assertions: Only trusted control content may supply authority.

scenarios.title: Prompt injection receives bounded review
scenarios.purpose: Detect suspicious instructions without granting them authority.
assertions: Retrieved instructions are treated as data.

scenarios.title: Exfiltration signal triggers containment
scenarios.purpose: Stop suspicious activity and preserve evidence.
assertions: Tool and credential grants are revoked.

scenarios.title: Untrusted executable content is sealed
scenarios.purpose: Require ephemeral isolation without network or secrets.
assertions: Execution has process isolation and cleanup.
Network and secret access are denied.

scenarios.title: Dependency provenance is enforced
scenarios.purpose: Reject unapproved or insufficiently traceable components.
assertions: Dependencies are pinned, approved, scanned, and provenance checked.

scenarios.title: Artifact identity is attested
scenarios.purpose: Bind outputs to the expected run, revision, builder, and materials.
assertions: Digest, revision, run identity, provenance, and signature match.
